title: Life & Annuities
meta_description: Life books run on decades-long promises: underwriting quality at issue, servicing responsiveness across 30-year relationships, and actuarial integrity a.

blocks.x: A working definition of Life & Annuities for Insurance & Risk: engineered controls, named owners, weekly evidence, and a signed baseline so every claim of improvement can be replayed line by line.
Before proposing anything, we map the context Life & Annuities will run in — regulators, decision cadence, existing contracts — because the design that ignores context fails at the gate.

blocks.title: Governed lakehouse pipeline — Life & Annuities
blocks.note: Contracts between stages are enforced at the boundary, so schema drift fails loudly in minutes instead of quietly in a quarter.

blocks.x: Every component in Life & Annuities has a contract, a version and a named owner. When something drifts, the ticket goes to a person, not to a committee — that is what the reference architecture is for.

items: Underwriting evidence assembly
Underwriting evidence assembly is where programs like this usually start: unglamorous, measurable and worth more than the technology conversation it replaces.
Actuarial data wrangling
Actuarial data wrangling is one of the pressures we hear first in estates like yours — the diagnostic puts a measured number on it before anything is promised.
Surrender and service queues
Surrender and service queues shows up in the first conversations with every team we meet in this space; the design gate assigns it an owner and a countermeasure.
Health and PII concentration
Health and PII concentration costs real money every quarter it goes unmeasured; the first two weeks of the engagement exist to price it honestly.
Admin platform drag
When Admin platform drag is the pain, the baseline audit usually confirms it is structural, not personal — the fix is designed for the system, not the people.
In-force management blind spots
In-force management blind spots costs real money every quarter it goes unmeasured; the first two weeks of the engagement exist to price it honestly.
streaming ingest
Events land in seconds, not overnight batches — the precondition for decisions that happen in the moment.
data contracts
Typed schemas with owners and freshness expectations, agreed before a pipeline is allowed to ship.
Unity Catalog governance
A single governance plane over tables, models and notebooks — access your auditors can replay.
cost-aware clustering
Workloads land on the cheapest compute that still meets the latency budget.
claims document intake
Documents classified and extracted on arrival — the adjuster starts with structure, not a PDF pile.
claims orchestration
Every claim moving through one orchestrated flow with SLAs visible to the people accountable for them.
policy admin platforms
Policy truth kept in the system of record; analytics and service read from it, not around it.
actuarial & pricing stores
Pricing basis and reserving data governed as one truth for underwriting and finance.
freshness SLO attainment
Up 97–99% of tables inside their declared window per 1,000 claims, reported weekly against the signed baseline
pipeline breakage MTTR
Breakage restored and measured — the repair clock starts at alert, not at someone noticing.
query p95
Query latency measured at p95 from real workloads — the number users feel is the number reported.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship

items: Metric anarchy
One definition per metric, owned and versioned — the dashboard and the board pack cannot disagree.
Cost creep
Unit costs on a published budget with alerts at the threshold — creep is caught by the meter, not by the invoice.
Silent schema drift
Contracts enforced at the boundary — schema drift fails the pipeline loudly, in minutes.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation
Digital workers with roles, budgets and human checkpoints — every action logged and reversible.
Data & Lakehouse
Valuation and experience pipelines with lineage for IFRS 17 — regime-change readiness without panic
Cyber & Zero-Trust
Identity-first security for people, machines and models — detection, response and audit in one program.
Cloud, Edge & Platform
Reliable estates at lower unit cost — hybrid multicloud, edge fleets and SRE discipline.
Applied AI & GenAI
Payment and engagement signals predicting lapse with action policy — retention actions timely

blocks.x: An engagement on Life & Annuities starts with a two-week baseline audit, runs a bounded pilot against a control group, and reaches its first gate with measured deltas — before any scale decision is made.

items: Underwriting case cycle time
Progress on Underwriting case cycle time is measured in your environment, on your data — the method note ships with the number so your analysts can reproduce it.
Servicing transaction STP
Servicing transaction STP is tracked weekly to your control owner; the number at gate three is the number finance sees
Valuation prep effort
Valuation prep effort defines success for this pattern and is audited against the week-two baseline at every gate
Lapse-save actions
Lapse-save actions carries the program: if the delta stalls, the gate redirects scope toward it before anything else
A top-5 global P&C insurer
The engagement is documented on its case page — what was measured, what moved and how the evidence was gathered.
A leading life insurer (North America)
The measured delta and the method note are written up on the case page — anonymized by agreement, baseline audited.
